owner_decision.note: The thresholds below are transcribed from section 5, first bullet, and nothing is added: 'argmax agreement >= 99.0% and mean |delta log p| of the gold letter <= 0.02 nats over >= 500 val prompts (never held-out), bf16 vs q8 vs q4, bars written before the run, mlx version named. family.label: procedure
family.pooling_rule: PROCEDURE, not a threshold. This family shares optimizer_recipe 'lora' with lora-2b by design (the trainer is unchanged), so a reader keyed on optimizer_recipe alone WOULD pool q8 rows with bf16 rows and must not. The pool key is (family id, base.format, base-file sha256): rows pool only when all three are equal. A row without all three is never pooled with any row of this family or of lora-2b.

base.label: procedure
base.format_note: The 150 wrapped linears are dequantize(quantize(W)) from mlx (affine, q8, group 64, bf16 scale and bias); every other tensor is the original. Dense bf16 safetensors; no quantised dtype or kernel is on the path (owner-decision section 3).
base.fakequant_file_sha256_rule: Every row of this family records the sha256 of the fake-quant base safetensors file it ran over, and the sha256 of its bf16 source file. A row without both is not a lora-2b-q8-registered row. The fake-quant file's sha256 is not known at filing time (the file is not written) and is not pre-filled.
base.mlx_version_note: Read from /Users/bharath/.venvs/ml/bin/python (mlx.core.__version__) on 2026-10-22. The gate verdict records the version it ran under; a different version is a different arm.

d3_gate.scope: validation prompts only, never held-out (rule 3). q4 is measured by the same tool under its own spec and is never built (owner-decision section 3); this block registers the q8 bar.

ledger.label: procedure
ledger.kind: every Mac row quick=true with a quick_reason naming the one seed and the truncated schedule
ledger.order: No quantised run starts before the bf16 reduced run's ledger row exists, and no row of this family is written before this file is committed (owner-decision section 3).
ledger.numbers: A number in a report cites a ledger row id (rule 5); a suite that could not run is reported as not run.
